name: Sapling of Colfenor

abilities.text: Whenever ~ attacks, reveal the top card of your library. If it's a creature card, you gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power, then put it into your hand.

notes: APPROXIMATION: no condition can ask whether the bound card ('that') is a creature card, so the life gain, the life loss and the move to hand run for whatever the top card is. A noncreature card has power and toughness 0, so the two life effects are correctly 0 for it; the deviation is that a noncreature card is also put into your hand instead of staying on top (see needs).

issues: If it's a creature card, ... then put it into your hand — expected a noncreature card stays on top of the library and no life is gained or lost — scripted no condition on the bound card; the move to hand runs unconditionally (script notes admit this). Blind scenario confirms: 'A revealed noncreature card stays on top of the library' failed — Lightning Bolt zone 'hand' !== 'library', library 20 !== 21 — CR CR 608.2a — an 'if' clause in the effect is checked on resolution and the dependent effects don't happen if false

reveal the top card of your library — expected the card is revealed — public information to all players — scripted op 'look-top' with who:'you' — private look, opponents never see the card — CR CR 701.15 (reveal) vs 701.14 (look at)

If it's a creature card, ... then put it into your hand. — expected a noncreature top card stays on top of the library and nothing else happens — scripted no condition; move 'that' to hand runs unconditionally. Blind scenario confirms: Lightning Bolt ended in hand, library 20 vs 21 — CR 608.2a

reveal the top card of your library — expected reveal — the card becomes public information to all players — scripted op 'look-top' (game.ts:1223) emits action:'look', not a reveal; only the controller sees it — CR 701.16

gain life equal to that card's toughness, lose life equal to its power — expected P/T of a card in the library — scripted {prop:'toughness'/'power', of:'that'} — render calls it 'that permanent's toughness'; works only because a library card falls back to printed P/T, and yields 0 for noncreature cards — CR 208.1
